title: On the Way Back
reference: F1(3) def F1 { forward F1 jump }
hints: A block after the call to F1 runs later, once the deeper calls have finished.
F1: forward, F1, jump. The jumps all happen at the end, one per level.
F1(3) def F1 { forward F1 jump }

story.intro: PATCH: "Anything after the call waits. It runs on the way back out, once for every level."
story.outro: PATCH: "Three forwards going in, three jumps coming out. The deepest call finished first."
